Richte dich neu aus. Auf deine Zukunft. Mit velpTEC.

Wir unterstützen Menschen durch unsere Bildungsangebote praxisnah dabei, ihre Fähigkeiten für künftige Zeiten zu stärken und damit aktiv ihren Lebensweg zu gestalten. Bereit für eine neue Mission? Dann entdecke jetzt deine Zukunftsperspektive bei velpTEC und werde Teil unseres multiprofessionellen und diversen Teams.

Jede Rolle hat einen eigenen Auftrag im Lebenszyklus eines Produkts, von der ersten Idee bis zum verlässlichen Betrieb. title: Engineering Manager (m/w/d) – Core Team
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst.

Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird.

Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung.

Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt.

Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert.

In den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle

  • Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut

  • Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen

Danach

  • Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung

  • Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird

  • Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis

  • Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen

  • Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede

  • Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun


Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler mit Web-Anwendungen in Produktion. Du kannst in Django und React produktiv arbeiten oder dich in wenigen Wochen dort einfinden

  • Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung

  • Du kannst ein Datenmodell beurteilen und eine Architekturdiskussion moderieren, ohne sie an dich zu reißen

  • Du willst wieder oder weiter Code schreiben, bevor du führst, und siehst das als Vorteil, nicht als Umweg

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in Messstellenbetrieb, Abrechnung, Marktkommunikation oder Mieterstrom. Du kennst Begriffe wie Messkonzept, MaLo oder OBIS nicht nur aus Wikipedia

  • Business-Verständnis: Du denkst vom Geschäftsmodell des Betreibers her, nicht vom Feature. Du kannst erklären, welche Anforderung Umsatz sichert, welche Risiko reduziert und welche nur schön ist

  • Du gibst direktes Feedback und hältst es aus, direktes Feedback zu bekommen

  • Du kannst Nein sagen, zu Stakeholdern und zum eigenen Team, und begründen, warum

  • Du fühlst dich in einem Startup wohl, in dem Strukturen noch entstehen und du sie mitgestaltest

  • Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, weil Fachlichkeit, Kunden und ein Großteil der Kommunikation deutsch sind


Warum wir?

  • Eine Führungsrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einer wachsenden Engineering-Organisation, mit einem Einstieg, der dich nicht ins kalte Wasser wirft

  • Direkter Draht zum CTO und Mitsprache bei der Teamstruktur, nicht nur bei der Umsetzung

  • Ein Team ohne Hierarchieebenen. Wer eine bessere Idee hat, setzt sie um

  • Ein Produkt, das die Energiewende konkret voranbringt, statt sie nur in die Präsentation zu schreiben

title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
description:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch.

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! 


YOUR TASKS

  • End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions.

  • Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed.

  • Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production.

  • Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start.

  • Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving.

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

  • You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations.

  • You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements.

  • You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially.

  • You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

  • Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products.

  • Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management.

  • Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing.

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

  • Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget

description:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we’re on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We create the snacks people genuinely crave, from chocolate bars and wafers to cookies, gummies, and protein bars, with up to 90% less sugar and no compromise on taste.

As our E-Commerce Campaign Manager, you’ll work at the intersection of our products, customer experience, and commercial growth. You’ll help shape how ahead brings ideas to life online and scales them across markets.

You’ll take ownership of our onsite campaigns and bring our overarching campaign strategy to life in our shop. You’ll improve the processes behind them, develop & implement new ideas for new campaign-related shop features, and turn campaign data into actionable insights. Working closely with our E-Commerce, Campaign, Brand, and Marketing teams, you’ll help make our campaigns more effective, scalable, and relevant across markets.

If you’re commercially curious, highly detail oriented, and motivated by the opportunity to shape both the customer experience and the way we do e-commerce, we’d love to hear from you!


YOUR TASKS

  • Onsite Campaign Experience & Launches: Plan and execute product launches, discount initiatives, and other commercial activities in the shop. Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders to ensure a smooth customer experience.

  • Content & Asset Ownership: Coordinate the creation of product and shop content, including images, copy, homepage content, launch pages, and other onsite assets. Take full responsibility for their quality, accuracy, and timely delivery, including localization for expansion markets. Ensure content is adapted to local needs and delivered consistently across countries.

  • Shop Development: Together with our Tech team, transform the campaign vision into new shop features, promotional mechanics, and onsite experiences that can improve customer engagement and commercial performance.

  • Process Improvement: Improve how onsite activities are planned, created, and delivered by establishing clearer workflows, strengthening collaboration and handovers, and reducing avoidable errors. Find ways to shorten delivery timelines and assess recurring tasks for automation or AI support. Develop scalable ways of working while using sound judgment about where communication, coordination, and creative thinking remain essential.

  • Performance & Insights: Analyze completed onsite activities, from product launch revenue and discount uplift to top-selling products and other relevant performance indicators, and translate your findings into clear recommendations for future initiatives.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You have practical experience in onsite campaign management, shop management, e-commerce, or a similar field. Hands-on experience with onsite campaigns or shop management is essential. 

  • You are highly organized, structured, and accurate. You have a low tolerance for errors and take full responsibility for the quality of your work, particularly when managing product copy, campaign assets, and launch details.

  • You combine attention to detail with commercial curiosity. You don’t just execute campaigns – you want to understand what drives performance, what can be improved, and how new ideas can create better results. 

  • You are proactive and hands-on. You identify problems, challenge inefficient processes, and follow through on solutions. You’re comfortable working across a broad range of tasks in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently in both German and English. You enjoy coordinating with multiple stakeholders and can work effectively with E-Commerce, Marketing, Brand & Design, and other internal teams.

  • You have a basic understanding of D2C business models, digital marketing, and e-commerce performance.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • You are confident working with Shopify. Hands-on Shopify experience is essential for this role.

  • You have worked in a D2C business.

  • You are familiar with Asana, Trello, or similar project management tools.

  • You understand shop and e-commerce performance and how onsite activities can contribute to commercial results.

  • A background in food, consumer goods, retail, or another high-campaign environment is a plus.

  • Experience improving processes, automating tasks, or using AI to work more efficiently is a plus.

  • Exposure to localization and international markets is a plus.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Berlin or Hamburg, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget

This role is based in Hamburg or Berlin, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you!
